sections.title: Service Architecture
body: Same per-project 4-layer pattern (ADR-013) used by every project on pandyaHomeLab. The browser sends text; the server returns a label, per-label probabilities, and the text after each preprocessing step.

sections.title: Network & Deployment
body: The NLP domain has its own bridge network (ADR-016). Only nlp-mlflow runs alongside the demos: postgres, MinIO and Redis have reserved addresses but are not deployed until a demo needs one (Phase 3 gate G1). The tracker is public, read-only, at `mlflow-nlp.pandyahomelab.com`.
No cross-network reach-back into ml-network or dl-network — each domain's tracking and demos are independent.
